name: Action
description: High-energy films built around physical conflict, stunts, and dynamic set pieces.

name: Adventure
description: Journey-driven stories involving exploration, danger, and discovery.

name: Anthology
description: Films composed of multiple, loosely connected stories or segments.

name: Biography
description: Dramatized accounts of real people's lives and achievements.

name: Comedy
description: Films designed primarily to entertain and amuse through humor.

name: Crime
description: Stories centered on criminal acts, investigations, or the underworld.

name: Devotional
description: Films centered on religious faith, mythology, and spiritual devotion.

name: Drama
description: Character-driven stories exploring realistic, often emotional situations.

name: Family
description: Films suitable for and centered on the dynamics of family life.

name: Fantasy
description: Stories set in imaginative worlds featuring magic or supernatural elements.

name: Historical
description: Films set in and inspired by real historical periods and events.

name: History
description: Films that dramatize significant real-world historical events.

name: Horror
description: Films designed to frighten, unsettle, or evoke dread in the audience.

name: Music
description: Films centered on musicians, musical performance, or a musical art form.

name: Mystery
description: Plot-driven stories built around solving a puzzle or hidden truth.

name: Mythology
description: Stories drawn from or inspired by traditional myths and epics.

name: Psychological
description: Films that explore the inner mental and emotional states of characters.

name: Romance
description: Stories centered on the development of romantic relationships.

name: Science Fiction
description: Speculative stories exploring futuristic or scientific concepts.

name: Spy Thriller
description: Suspense films centered on espionage and covert operations.

name: Superhero
description: Films centered on characters with extraordinary powers and heroic missions.

name: Survival
description: Stories centered on characters fighting to endure extreme circumstances.

name: Thriller
description: Suspense-driven films designed to keep audiences on edge.

name: War
description: Films depicting armed conflict and its impact on soldiers and civilians.

name: Animation
description: Films created using animated visual techniques rather than live action.

name: Musical
description: Films where songs and dance numbers are central to the storytelling.

name: Sports
description: Films centered on athletes, competition, and the world of sport.

name: Coming-of-Age
description: Stories that follow a character's growth from youth toward maturity.

name: Neo-Noir
description: Modern films that draw on the moody, cynical style of classic film noir.

name: Period Drama
description: Dramas set in a distinct, carefully recreated historical era.

name: Black Comedy
description: Films that combine dark, serious situations with irony or unconventional humor.

name: Documentary
description: Non-fiction films built around real people, events, places, or subjects.

name: Heist
description: Stories focused on carefully planned robberies, elaborate schemes, and high-stakes escapes.

name: Slasher
description: Horror stories built around relentless threats, suspense, and survival.

name: Dark Comedy
description: Comedies that find humor in uncomfortable, serious, or morally complicated situations.

name: Political Drama
description: Character-driven stories shaped by political institutions, power, and public conflict.

name: Courtroom
description: Stories centered on legal cases, trials, evidence, and courtroom strategy.

name: Disaster
description: Stories involving large-scale natural or man-made disasters and their consequences.

name: Martial Arts
description: Action films emphasizing martial arts training, combat, and disciplined fighting.

name: Road Movie
description: Journey-focused films in which travel becomes central to the characters' stories.

name: Teen
description: Films focused on teenage characters, friendships, identity, and everyday challenges.

name: Slice of Life
description: Grounded stories focused on ordinary experiences, relationships, and everyday life.

name: Supernatural
description: Stories involving ghosts, unexplained forces, or events beyond ordinary reality.

name: Espionage
description: Stories centered on intelligence agencies, secret missions, surveillance, and covert operations.

name: Epic
description: Large-scale stories featuring sweeping conflicts, ambitious worlds, and major dramatic stakes.
